flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck of OCMS)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/{ReductionController,ReductionServiceImpl,helpers/ReductionValidator,helpers/ReductionPersistenceService,dto/ReductionRequest} (POST /v1/plus-apply-reduction, called by PLUS). ocmsadminui pages/Notice/detail/SuspensionDetail.tsx (Reduced Amount field not bound to data), utils/models/Fnotice.d.ts:536. Everything else: no reduction code
note: Story status: Requirement given - Gen flow (2 points). Same as OCMS16.6: OCMS receives amountReduced (dollars) and amountPayable already computed by PLUS, validates the arithmetic and stores it; there is no calculation from a fixed amount/percentage, no percentage at all, and no display of the reduced amount for verification (the SuspensionDetail.tsx field uses source UNKNOWN). The verify/confirm screen in PLUS: cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-072 does not change the verdict of the steps in this story.
recommendation: Do not claim as complete. The reduced-amount calculation and display are not in OCMS; only the dollar amount and the confirmed result from PLUS are received. Ask URA/the team to confirm whether this is built in PLUS.

steps.step: Officer has applied a reduction of a fixed amount or percentage to the searched notices
steps.detail: A dollar amount is accepted through POST /plus-apply-reduction as amountReduced (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/dto/ReductionRequest.java:37, ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/ReductionController.java:29); a percentage does not exist (the type "custom-precentage" at ocmsadminui/src/utils/models/Fnotice.d.ts:536 is unused) and the OCMS staff portal has no reduction action. Same as OCMS16.7 steps 2-3; input in PLUS: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS computes the reduced composition amount from the fixed amount/percentage
steps.detail: OCMS does not compute the reduced amount itself. amountReduced and amountPayable arrive ready-made from PLUS (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/dto/ReductionRequest.java:37, :43). OCMS only validates: amountReduced must be lower than the current amount payable (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionValidator.java:179) and amountPayable must equal current - amountReduced (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionValidator.java:188-195); a mismatch is rejected (INCONSISTENT_AMOUNTS). There is no per-stage or percentage formula. The stage/rule code eligibility (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:56-67) only decides allowed or not, not the amount.

steps.step: OCMS displays the reduced composition amount to the officer
steps.detail: There is no screen that shows the reduced amount for verification. The only 'Reduced Amount' label is in ocmsadminui/src/pages/Notice/detail/SuspensionDetail.tsx: the block at lines 173-181 is commented out and the field at lines 244-247 uses source "UNKNOWN" (not bound to any data), so it never shows a value. There is no preview screen before confirmation in ocmsadminui; a screen in PLUS cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: Officer verifies and confirms the reduction of the composition amount
steps.detail: Confirmation does not happen in the OCMS staff portal. OCMS only receives the confirmed result through POST /plus-apply-reduction from PLUS (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/ReductionController.java:29-59) and then runs applyReduction (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/ReductionServiceImpl.java:113). The verify/confirm screen in PLUS is not in the six repos: cannot verify from repo. The endpoint is excluded from JwtFilter and the authorization interceptor (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/config/WebConfig.java:83); protection depends on APIM, cannot verify from repo.
